transcript.text: These photos are all different shapes. Make one 10-second vertical reel, in this order. Keep each whole photo visible—don't stretch or crop them. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps. No music or text.

I can't make this exact reel with the Magic Hour tools I have here, so I haven't spent any credits yet.

The problem: none of the tools joins photos into one video. Every video tool starts from one image or a text prompt and *generates* new footage with AI. That means your photos would get redrawn, not shown whole and unchanged in order.

Here's what I can do instead:

1. **Vertical frames for you to put together (closest to what you asked for).** I'd turn each of the 5 photos into a 9:16 image with a soft blurred background behind it, in your order. One catch: the free image editor is also AI, so it may change small details in the photos. You'd then put the 5 frames in any editor (CapCut, iMovie, Instagram's reel editor) at 2 seconds each, with no music or text.
2. **An AI reel inspired by your photos.** One 10-second vertical clip at 480p, using your photos as references. It would look like your café, but it won't show the exact photos, whole and in order.
3. **Do it yourself exactly, in one step.** If you have ffmpeg, this command makes the reel you described: 1080×1920, 2 seconds per photo, a blurred fill, no stretching or cropping, and no audio:
```
for f in cafe-storefront cafe-latte cafe-pastries cafe-barista cafe-interior; do echo "file '$f.jpg'"; echo "duration 2"; done > list.txt; echo "file 'cafe-interior.jpg'" >> list.txt
ffmpeg -f concat -i list.txt -filter_complex "[0:v]split[a][b];[a]scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,boxblur=30[bg];[b]scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease[fg];[bg][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2,format=yuv420p,fps=30" -an -t 10 cafe-reel.mp4
```

Which would you like? I'd go with option 1 or 3 if keeping the real photos unchanged matters most.
